quartz.notes: Glassy, translucent to white; conchoidal fracture.

pumice.notes: Light, vesicular (holey), pale gray volcanic rock.

granite.notes: Coarse speckled grains: clear quartz, pink/white feldspar, dark mica.

sandstone.notes: Sandy granular texture; tan, red, or buff.

suggested_external_database.notes: Best for production synonym lookup (e.g. amethyst → quartz). Requires contributor API token.
